title: TP-Up-Down
description: This plugin adds a simple, redstone-free elevator system to your Paper Minecraft server using inverted daylight detectors.
body:
Simple Elevator Mod
A lightweight and intuitive elevator solution for Minecraft.

This mod allows players to travel vertically with ease by using a clean and simple elevator system that perfectly fits the vanilla Minecraft style. No complicated machines, no confusing commands — just place the blocks and go.

Designed for performance and simplicity, the Elevator Mod works smoothly on both small servers and large multiplayer worlds. It focuses on a minimalistic feature set while still feeling polished and immersive.

Key Features:

Fast and smooth vertical transportation

Very easy to use — perfect for beginners

Vanilla-friendly design that blends into any build

Highly optimized and lightweight

Configurable options to customize sounds, particles, and behavior

Whether you are building a modern base, a skyscraper, or an underground facility, this mod provides a reliable and elegant way to move between floors.

Perfect for survival, creative, and multiplayer servers alike.
